id.description:
This field should usually not be set to anything else. Only change if
the configs are stored on a different {@link UiSdlSite}.

configType.description:
The type name of the config to access.

Note that this actually represents the field on `SDL.DefaultSite.configs` to access.

path.description:
The path on {@link #configType} to access the configuration that specifies whether
a component ref should be rendered.

title: Type to specify the config and path that determine if a component-ref should be rendered.
name: UiConfigDynamicFilterSpecParam
